description: Python for Power System Analysis (PyPSA) Version 0.14.1 is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Tom Brown, Jonas Hörsch (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology). Python for Power System Analysis (PyPSA) is a free software toolbox for simulating and optimising modern power systems that include features such as conventional generators with unit commitment, variable wind and solar generation, storage units, sector coupling and mixed alternating and direct current networks. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is GPL-3.0.
